title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Costa Rica has probably the most wholesome food we’ve had on our travels. The casado is the most perfectly balanced meal with all the macronutrients one would want.
In Monteverde, our go to spots were Soda la Amistad, Sabor Tico, and Soda la Coati. In San Jose, we dined at La Criollita and Cafe Rojo.
